title: NCAA: Eligado’s perfect game fuels Jose Rizal U past LPU
summary: Jose Rizal University bounced back in style, dominating Lyceum of the Philippines University, 94-69, in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Tuesday evening at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
